Enable installed packs below. Manage or download independent packs from GitHub Releases. Automatic routing reuses local OCR; it does not rewrite your formula.
Templates replace the editor text after confirmation; they are not recognition results.
This replaces the current LaTeX editor text. Your original handwriting stays unchanged until you insert the formula block.
